features.name: Text Analysis (I'rab & Sharaf)
features.description: AI-powered Arabic text analysis for grammar (I'rab), morphology (Sharaf), vocalization, and rhetorics (Balaghah). Supports export to Markdown, TXT, and DOC formats.

features.name: Digital Kitab Library
features.description: Interactive digital library featuring 4 classical Arabic books (Alfiyyah, Al-Ajurrumiyyah, Nazham Al-Imriti, Qawaid). Includes bookmarks, highlights, translations, footnotes, and adjustable text size.

features.name: AI Assistant Chat
features.description: Interactive chat with AI expert for Arabic grammar Q&A. Supports conversation history and markdown-formatted responses.

features.name: Live Audio Tutor
features.description: Real-time voice conversation with AI tutor using Web Speech API for speech recognition and text-to-speech in Saudi Arabic.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User authentication with email/password login, registration, and password reset using Supabase Auth.

features.name: Theme Toggle (Dark Mode)
features.description: Premium dark mode with smooth animations and gradient design. Theme preference persisted in localStorage.

features.name: Payment Integration
features.description: Midtrans payment gateway integration for subscription and premium features.

features.name: API Key Settings
features.description: User interface for managing API keys (Gemini, Maiarouter, Midtrans) with secure storage.

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Main navigation with tabs for different sections (Analysis, Kitab, AI Assistant, Live Tutor).

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard application that orchestrates all features and user flow.
